audience: Capable zero-prerequisite learner with ordinary computer-use skills
purpose: Bridge local Git work to the already-required public GitHub repository and Pull Request
starting_point: Learner understands local repositories, commits, diffs, and branches but has not been taught remote creation or authentication
must_teach: How to create an empty GitHub repository for an existing local project
How browser-based GitHub CLI authentication works
How origin connects the local and hosted repositories
How to publish main and the feature branch
How to open and interpret a Pull Request
editorial_protocol: Handcrafted Writing and Editorial Quality Protocol
